summary: Complete architectural, security, and mobile-first implementation plan for Warden AI. Integrates Firebase Authentication (Google & Email/Password), server-enforced RBAC, mobile-first responsive UX (320px–1440px), multi-scenario character creation (0 to N scenarios), 11-category tagging matrix with AND/OR filtering, BYOK multi-provider engine, publishing/moderation queues, age-verification and NSFW blur protection, private conversation protection, and a two-person restricted investigation module with tamper-evident audit logging.
